newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GALLAGHER , TOCO BOUNCE OFF LOWS.
newsitem.headline: GALLAGHER , TOCO BOUNCE OFF LOWS.

text.p: Shares in South African firms Gallagher Ltd and Toco Holdings Ltd both bounced off their recent lows on Wednesday as buyers crept back into the stocks, dealers said.
By about 1000 GMT Gallagher was up five, or 5.5 percent, to 104 cents and Toco rose three cents, or 8.57 percent, to 38 cents.
Both stocks saw relatively good volumes with more than a million Toco shares being traded and 178,300 Gallagher shares changing hands.

Toco has been sliding all year and has issued two profit warnings so far in 1997, the most recent coming in May, while Gallagher slid on Tuesday after posting another set of year results firmly in the red.
"Gallagher is just bouncing back after taking a whack yesterday (Tuedsay)," one dealer said.
